SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S. B. REGISTRY
S. 4. D. 2956.
Season,
17. 11. 31.
Date December 16, 1931

Subject (in full) Meeting of "Conscience Group for National Salvation"
members in Chinese Y.M.C.A.

Made by D.S.I. Moore Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

With reference to the attached instructions of the
Officer i/c Special Branch, the opinion of the Commissioner of
Police regarding the use of the Chinese Y.M.C.A. by outsiders,
was imparted to Mr. L.T. Chen, who stated that non-members of
the organization were permitted to participate in the meeting
on December 13 through a misunderstanding of his instructions.
He has, however, issued a further instruction that participants
in meetings on Y.M.C.A. premises must be members of the
Association.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commissioner of Police,
For Information
J.M. Stevens
O. i/c S. B.

主题（全称）：“救国良心团”成员在中华基督教青年会举行的会议

由特别科督察穆尔（Moore）呈报，经警司罗伯逊（Tho Robertson）转呈

参照随附的特别科主管警官指令，已将警务处处长关于外人使用中华基督教青年会场所的意见告知陈立廷（L.T. Chen）先生，他表示，由于对其指令的误解，允许非该组织成员参加了12月13日的会议。然而，他已发出进一步指令，规定在青年会场所举行的会议，参与者必须是该会会员。

特别科督察

特别科主管警官。

警务处处长，
供阅知
J.M. Stevens
特别科主管

REPORT
Date December 15/31.
File No..........

Subject (in full) Meeting of "Conscience Group for National
Salvation" Members in Chinese Y.M.C.A.

Made by D.S.I. Moore Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt

In accordance with instructions contained in attached
memorandum relating to a meeting of "Conscience Group for
National Salvation" Members in the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 201
Szechuen Road, on December 13, Mr. L.T. Chen, General Secretary
of the Y.M.C.A. was interviewed during the morning of December
15 at his office in the Kincheng Banking Corp. Building,
Kiangse Road.

Mr. Chen was apparently not familiar as to who held
the meeting and as to what took place, and after a telephone
conversation with one of the executive staff of the Chinese
Y.M.C.A., stated that only about one-third of the attendance
at the meeting on December 13, were members of the Y.M.C.A.
The remainder, he declared, although outsiders were law abiding,
and not at all likely to associate themselves with radical
elements.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

日期：1931年12月15日
档案号..........

主题（全称）：“救国良心团”成员在中华基督教青年会举行的会议

由特别科督察穆尔（Moore）呈报，经警司罗伯逊（Thos Robertson）转呈

根据随附备忘录中关于12月13日在四川路201号中华基督教青年会举行的“救国良心团”成员会议的指令，于12月15日上午在江西路金城银行大楼办公室会见了青年会总干事陈立廷（L.T. Chen）先生。

陈先生显然不熟悉是谁举行了会议以及会议内容，在与中华基督教青年会一名执行人员通电话后，他表示，参加12月13日会议的人员中，只有约三分之一是青年会会员。他宣称，其余人员虽然是外人，但守法，完全不可能与激进分子有牵连。

特别科督察

特别科主管警官。

特别科主管
已阅。陈先生向我保证，
他不允许外人举行会议——仅限
青年会会员。我认为他应尽可能
信守这一承诺
拉什比（Rushby）
12月16日
特别科主管
1931年12月15日 15:12

1931年12月14日情报报告摘录。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2956.
9. 12. 31.
December 7, 1931

MEETING OF VARIOUS PUBLIC BODIES.

At 7 p.m. yesterday fifty persons representing
30 local public bodies including the North-East Fellow
Provincials Association in Shanghai, the Association of
Returned Students from Japan, the Union of Ricsha Coolies,
the Union of Wharf coolies of Japanese Shipping Companies,
the Union of Newspaper Distributors, the Union of Hotel
Porters, the Association of "Alarm Clocks", the People's
Committee of "Advance", etc., held a meeting at Y.M.C.A.,
201 Szechuen Road. Chen Nee Kung, representative of the
North-East Fellow Provincials Association in Shanghai,
presided. The following resolutions were passed:-
(1) That a body to be known as "The Grand Anti-Japanese
Association of the Chinese People " be formed.
(2) That an Executive Committee of 15 members be appointed.
(3) That the question of general strike of workers, merchants
and students be submitted to the Executive Committee for
consideration.
(4) That a circular be issued protesting against the Nanking
Government and the Canton Government.
(5) That a telegram be sent to the League of Nations rejecting
the recognition of Dr. Alfred Sze.
(6) That a circular be issued requesting students throughout
the country to go on strike as a protest against the
arrest of Peiping students at Nanking.
(7) That an "Execution Group" be organized for the purpose of
assassinating members of the Anti-Japanese Committee who
betrayed the people.
(8) That a general meeting be held at the Recreation Ground
at West Gate at 1 p.m. December 13.in order to organize .
a big demonstration.
(9) To overthrow the Committee Opposing Japan which is under
the control of the Central Government.
The meeting terminated at 11.20 p.m.
Amongst those present at the meeting were a
large number of communists. The members of the newly
elected executive committee will hold a meeting at Y.M.C.A.
this morning.
The representatives of the merchants and of the
large labour unions in Shanghai, including the Postal Workers
Union, the Union of Workers of the Electricity and Waterworks
Companies at Nantao and Chapel, did not attend the above
meeting because General Ho Ying Ching, Minister of War, and
Chao Lih Ts, Secretary to General Chiang Kai Shek, had
approached Yu Yah Ching, Wong Shao Lan as well as Loh Ching
Sz, a postal worker, who is also an influential member of
the Postal Workers Union.

9. 12.

1931年12月9日。
1931年12月7日

各公共团体会议。

昨晚7时，代表包括上海东北同乡会、留日同学会、人力车夫工会、日本轮船公司码头工人工会、报纸分销商工会、旅馆搬运工工会、“闹钟”协会（音译）、“前进”人民委员会等30个本地公共团体的50人，在四川路201号青年会举行会议。上海东北同乡会代表陈尼公（Chen Nee Kung，音译）担任主席。通过以下决议：
(1) 成立一个名为“中国人民大抗日协会”的组织。
(2) 任命一个由15名成员组成的执行委员会。
(3) 将工人、商人和学生总罢工的问题提交执行委员会审议。
(4) 发布通告，抗议南京政府和广州政府。
(5) 向国际联盟发送电报，拒绝承认施肇基（Dr. Alfred Sze）博士。
(6) 发布通告，要求全国学生罢工，以抗议在北平学生在南京被捕。
(7) 组织一个“行动组”，目的是刺杀背叛人民的抗日委员会成员。
(8) 于12月13日下午1时在西门游乐场举行全体会议，以组织大规模示威。
(9) 推翻受中央政府控制的反日委员会。
会议于晚上11时20分结束。
出席会议者中有大量共产党员。新当选的执行委员会成员将于今天上午在青年会举行会议。
上海商界代表和大型工会代表，包括邮政工人工会、南市和闸北水电公司工人工会的代表，未出席上述会议，因为军政部长何应钦将军和蒋介石将军的秘书赵李氏（Chao Lih Ts，音译）曾接触余亚清（Yu Yah Ching，音译）、黄少兰（Wong Shao Lan，音译）以及罗成思（Loh Ching Sz，音译，一名邮政工人，也是邮政工人工会中有影响力的成员）。

12月9日。
